facts.raw_span: a 2-year history of progressive abdominal distension
accompanied by early satiety and urinary urgency
denied pain, weight loss, or systemic symptoms
her menstrual cycles were normal
her mother had a history of ovarian cysts
the abdomen was distended with dull percussion notes but without tenderness or guarding
a cyst measuring 16 × 24 cm
a large midline intraperitoneal cyst, 30 × 25.6 × 16.8 cm in size
the lesion had a fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units
demonstrated no calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations
laboratory studies, including α-fetoprotein, carcinoembryonic antigen, cancer antigen 19-9, and cancer antigen 125, were all within normal limits
the Risk of Malignancy Algorithm (ROMA) score was 4.1 %

concepts.why: The patient's mother had a history of ovarian cysts and the patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst, suggesting a possible ovarian cyst.
The patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst, which could be a mesenteric cyst given its location and size.
The patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst with a fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units, suggesting a possible peritoneal inclusion cyst.
The patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst and laboratory studies showed normal tumor markers, suggesting a possible mucinous cystadenoma.
The patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst and a low Risk of Malignancy Algorithm (ROMA) score, suggesting a possible serous cystadenoma.
The patient presented with a large midline intraperitoneal cyst with a fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units and no calcifications or soft-tissue components, suggesting a possible simple cyst.
The absence of calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations in the cyst suggests a benign etiology, consistent with a lymphatic malformation.

rationales.F01: Progressive abdominal distension is more typical of ovarian cysts and other large abdominal cysts.
rationales.F05: Family history of ovarian cysts increases the likelihood of ovarian cyst.
rationales.F07: A large cyst measuring 16 × 24 cm is more typical of ovarian cysts and other large abdominal cysts.
rationales.F08: A large midline intraperitoneal cyst is more typical of ovarian cysts and other large abdominal cysts.

frontier_selector.rationale: The large midline intraperitoneal cyst with a fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units and no calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations suggests a benign etiology, and the location and size of the cyst are more consistent with a mesenteric cyst.
